(2) Subject to the provisions of this Act, where a judgment
is registered in terms of this Act, such registered judgment
shall be deemed to have the same force and effect and the
same  control  over  the  execution  of  such  judgment  as  if  it
had been a judgment originally given in the registering court

(3) Where, as at the date of application for recognition
and registration of a foreign judgment, a part of the relief
awarded  by  the  original  court  has  been  satisfied,  the
registering court may enforce the judgment only in respect
of the unsatisfied part of the judgment.
